IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Carrell, Roach, Kastama, McCaslin, and Regala

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring superior courts and courts of limited jurisdiction to use electronic recording equipment to record oral proceedings.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electronic recording of court proceedings;amending RCW 3.02.030 and 3.02.040; and adding new sections to chapter2.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 3.02.030 and 1980 c 162 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((The supreme court may, by court rule, establish a method ofmaking a record of the proceedings of a)) All courts of limitedjurisdiction must use electronic recording equipment to record oraltestimony and other oral proceedings for purposes of review.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 3.02.040 and 1980 c 162 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The administrator for the courts shall supervise the selection,installation, and operation of ((any)) the electronic recordingequipment used in courts of limited jurisdiction.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All of the superior courts must use electronic recording equipmentto record oral testimony and other oral proceedings for purposes ofreview.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The administrator for the courts shall supervise the selection,installation, and operation of the electronic recording equipment usedin the superior courts.
